This page is intended for mathematical notes, expository articles, and resources developed while studying and teaching mathematics.

## Topics

- Differential geometry
- Spin geometry and Dirac operators
- Differential topology
- Representation theory
- Functional analysis

## Notes and documents

Add notes as separate `.qmd` files and link them here. Quarto supports LaTeX-style mathematics, for example,

$$
D : \Gamma(S) \longrightarrow \Gamma(S),
$$

where \(D\) denotes a Dirac operator acting on sections of a spinor bundle \(S\).

You can also write inline mathematics, such as \(\mathrm{Spin}(4) \cong \mathrm{SU}(2)\times\mathrm{SU}(2)\).

### How to add a note

1. Create a new file, for example `dirac-operator.qmd`.
2. Add a title and write your text in Markdown with LaTeX mathematics.
3. Render the site with `quarto render`.
4. Add a link to the note on this page.
